Contract ManageLoanTermCRUDService::createLoanTerm(itemid: Integer,content: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		matchingTerms: Set(LoanTerm) = LoanTerm.allInstance()->select(o|o.ItemID = itemid and
		o.Content = content),
		toCreate: Boolean = if matchingTerms.isEmpty() = true 
		then true 
		else false 
		endif 
	precondition:
		itemid.oclIsTypeOf(Integer) and
		content.oclIsTypeOf(String)
	postcondition:
		let lt: LoanTerm in
		toCreate = true and
		lt.oclIsNew() and
		LoanTerm.allInstance()->includes(lt) and
		lt.ItemID = itemid and
		lt.Content = content and
		result = toCreate or
		toCreate = false and
		result = toCreate
}
